answer: The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the anchor of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on independent re-execution of receipts before any claim. The thread is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the tide. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short.
